ordering_caveat: Fresh pod metadata was captured after the first embedding cache completion, not retroactively claimed to precede inference. Both embedding containers have the same pinned image and unchanged restart count/start time as the earlier metadata-only inspection; no intervening container restart is observed.
model_response_binding: Every actual new embedding batch explicitly requested the frozen GTE model and required response.model equality before cache writes.
secrets: Only allowlisted pod image/version/start metadata and synonym-file SHA were inspected. No secret values or broad environment dump.
